load_ratio_basis: Cooling load per active cooling unit divided by configured cooling-unit rated design capacity.
design_basis_limitation: The current normalized load ratio is an engineering design-basis assumption pending vendor confirmation of design flow, head, water-side DeltaT, and pump performance data.
notes: Workbook Metadata status is Preliminary; the curve is an engineering placeholder pending vendor data. Normal and Failure use the same Solver_Curve; the configured cooling-unit rated design capacity is unchanged while active unit count changes.
